name: Ines Varga
note: Invented person for the demo. Every fact here was written by the candidate, so it counts as confirmed.

facts.text: Worked as a support engineer at Tandvik Software from March 2021 to June 2024.
Tandvik Software makes appointment scheduling software for dental clinics in Sweden.
The appointment-sync retry service was a ticket assigned to Ines by her team lead in Q3 2023. It was not her idea.
In the first month after the retry service shipped, failed appointment syncs dropped by 12 percent.
Completed a part-time data science certificate at Solbacka College in 2024.
